title: GENERAL Super Loto retrospective audit
scope: Current repository source files and unit tests
Current super_loto_archive.json metadata and row structure
GitHub Actions runs for method candidate tests and evaluation

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: A previous assistant response attributed an old method description to V17 without a source artifact/version trace that independently proves the attribution.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Withdraw that attribution as unverified. The three implementations remain explicitly experimental and OPEN_DEFINITION.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: Contiguous folds of the same expanding-window walk-forward scores were described as cross-validation too strongly.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Renamed output to chronological_fold_summaries; explicitly states these are summaries of the same walk-forward predictions, not nested CV and not per-fold model selection.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: Prior candidate evaluation compared only observed mean hits with the theoretical 0.6 baseline and did not quantify random-pick variation.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Added a reproducible 1000-replication Monte Carlo random 6-of-60 reference scored against the same historical test draws; reports a 95% interval and one-sided tail probability. This is descriptive and does not adjust for multiple hypotheses.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: evaluate_rows accepted a generic iterable but passed it to validate_archive before materializing it; a one-shot generator could be consumed before evaluation.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Materialize rows once before validation; added a generator-input regression test.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: The previous description did not clearly distinguish structural Data Guard checks from independent source verification of all years.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Current archive metadata shows the explicit cross-source comparison covers 2025 only (156 records). Do not describe all years as independently cross-verified.

random_reference.method: Monte Carlo random 6-of-60 picks on the exact same historical target draws

latest_candidate_results.interpretation: No candidate demonstrates clear evidence of advantage in this descriptive comparison. Do not treat the tail probabilities as definitive inferential p-values or as proof of absence/presence of a mechanism.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: Prior project memory reports 2025 archive counts of 160 in some versions, while the current archive fetcher and current cross-source validation report 156 records for 2025.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: Reconcile by inspecting exact date sets and source records for every disputed version before treating either count as canonical.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: Independent cross-source verification is currently recorded only for 2025; other years including 2026 have structural Data Guard validation but are not independently cross-verified by the current fetcher.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: Add independent source checks for all years or clearly label the scope in reports.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: The three method candidates are not canonical definitions from the historical V17/V19 implementation; their results must not be represented as reproduction of those versions.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: Trace the original formulas and versioned code artifacts, then compare them before promotion.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: No nested time-series model-selection protocol or multiple-hypothesis correction has been implemented.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: If model/feature tuning begins, introduce nested chronological validation and adjust for hypothesis search.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: The historical archive is treated as the source dataset after structural checks; this audit did not independently verify every draw against an official source.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: Do not claim complete real-world archive correctness until independent year-by-year reconciliation is complete.

next_step_blocked_until: Resolve 2025 record-count discrepancy and source provenance for canonical method definitions before presenting candidates as reproductions or advancing to model tuning.
